name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing space?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home office addition involves constructing new square footage onto your existing home, providing a completely new space for your office. A renovation, conversely, reconfigures or updates an existing room within your home to serve as an office. An addition typically offers more flexibility in design and layout, but also incurs higher costs and a longer timeline due to new foundation work and extensive construction. The choice depends on available land, budget, and desired spatial separation.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition builds new space, offering more design flexibility but higher cost and longer timelines. Renovation reworks an existing room.
